references.text: Jesus prays that if it is possible, this cup might pass from him, yet not as he wills but as God wills.
Jesus prays that the cup might pass from him, but adds that God's will must be done.
In Gethsemane, Jesus prays that the cup might pass from him, but submits to God's will.
The Lord has a cup of his wrathful wine, symbolizing punishment and suffering.
The nations must drink from the Lord's cup of wrath, which leads to stumbling.
